gapp.l: Histological pattern: Large and irregular cell nest. 1 point. ADDS with the other pattern feature - they are NOT alternatives, and a tumor showing both scores 2.
Histological pattern: Pseudorosette, even if focal. 1 point. ADDS with the other pattern feature - they are NOT alternatives, and a tumor showing both scores 2.

Cellularity, counted in cells per unit area at a specified magnification and therefore operator-dependent [low = Low, under 150 cells per unit area, 0 points; moderate = Moderate, 150 to 250 cells per unit area, 1 points; high = High, over 250 cells per unit area, 2 points]
Ki-67 labelling index band [under-1 = Under 1 percent, 0 points; 1-to-3 = 1 to 3 percent, 1 points; over-3 = Over 3 percent, 2 points]
Vascular or capsular invasion. 1 point if present.

Catecholamine type, a BIOCHEMICAL variable from 24-hour urine fractionated metanephrine and normetanephrine, NOT from the slide. NON-MONOTONIC: non-functioning scores the same as adrenergic and LESS than noradrenergic [non-functioning = Non-functioning, 0 points; adrenergic = Adrenergic: raised urine metanephrine, with or without raised normetanephrine, 0 points; noradrenergic = Noradrenergic: raised urine normetanephrine without raised metanephrine, 1 points]

gastric-emptying-scintigraphy.l: Meal still in the stomach at 1 hour: normal 30 to 90, below 30 is rapid
Meal still in the stomach at 2 hours: delayed above 60
Meal still in the stomach at 4 hours: the value that grades the study, delayed above 10
Blood glucose at the time of the study
Drugs that speed emptying up or slow it down were stopped two days beforehand
